description: This file contains unit tests for the RemoveKeySession functionality of the Rialto media key management system, specifically testing success and failure scenarios for removing a key session.

classes.name: RialtoServerMediaKeysRemoveKeySessionTest
classes.description: A test fixture class inheriting from MediaKeysTestBase, setting up media keys and key session for testing removeKeySession functionality.

methods.name: RialtoServerMediaKeysRemoveKeySessionTest
methods.description: Constructor initializing media keys and key session for tests.

methods.description: Destructor cleaning up media keys after tests.

methods.name: Success
methods.description: Test case verifying that removeKeySession succeeds when called correctly.
